candidates.source_name: Česká bankovní asociace (ČBA) — hlavní web / zpravodajský servis
candidates.why_relevant: Main public site of the Czech Banking Association (34 members, >99% of the CZ banking sector). Publishes news, commentary and the association reading of regulatory change; acts as the hub pointing to standards, commissions, calendar and media outputs. English mirror at /en.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled HTML crawl of section index pages + article pages; check for RSS; polite rate limit, cs+en variants
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query + snowball from search results
queries_used: Česká bankovní asociace stanovisko legislativa připomínky
ČBA komise pracovní skupiny cbaonline.cz tiskové zprávy regulace bankovní daň

candidates.source_name: ČBA — Bankovní regulace (topic hub)
candidates.why_relevant: Dedicated ČBA topic page explaining and tracking banking regulation — the association's own framing of rules issued by authorised bodies. Useful as a stable landing page whose linked articles carry the industry commentary on new/expected regulation.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: HTML fetch of hub page, extract outbound article links, diff over time
queries_used: ČBA komise pracovní skupiny cbaonline.cz tiskové zprávy regulace bankovní daň

candidates.source_name: ČBA — Kodexy a standardy (codes & standards)
candidates.why_relevant: ČBA is the author of binding-by-commitment sector standards and codes (self-regulation). These are quasi-regulatory instruments with their own effective dates and are the concrete industry response to EU/CZ rules. Directly relevant to A3 deadlines and to payments (open banking, client mobility, bank identity).
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Paginated crawl (observed ?limit=&offset= pagination) + PDF harvest of each standard, track version/effective dates
queries_used: cbaonline.cz "ČBA standard" standardy pro banky
candidates.observed_blocker: https://www.cbaonline.cz/kodexy-a-standardy returned a 404 page; the non-www form https://cbaonline.cz/kodexy-a-standardy is the working variant (hypothesis: host/redirect inconsistency, not a dead page)

candidates.source_name: ČBA — Komise a pracovní skupiny (commissions & working groups)
candidates.why_relevant: Maps the internal expert commissions/sub-commissions/working groups staffed by member banks (legislation, payments, AML, etc.). This is the actor map of who drafts ČBA positions — high-value pointer for identifying named experts, topic ownership and where a given consultation response originates.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off HTML scrape + quarterly re-check for structure changes; feed names into person/entity registry
queries_used: ČBA komise pracovní skupiny cbaonline.cz tiskové zprávy regulace bankovní daň

candidates.source_name: ČBA — Kalendář akcí (regulatory/event calendar)
candidates.why_relevant: The association's own event calendar — conferences, seminars and briefings are typically scheduled around regulatory milestones (transposition deadlines, ČNB/MF consultations). Cheap forward-looking signal for A3 deadlines.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Weekly HTML scrape of calendar listing; look for iCal/JSON feed behind the widget
queries_used: cbaonline.cz navigation fetch

candidates.source_name: ČBA — Pro média / tiskové zprávy (press room)
candidates.why_relevant: Press releases are where ČBA publicly criticises or welcomes draft legislation (e.g. bank tax, consumer credit, payments) and where dates and named spokespeople appear. Fastest-moving ČBA channel for regulatory reaction.
candidates.legal_status: public website; press material generally reproducible with attribution
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Daily/weekly listing crawl + full-text article extraction; dedupe against news wires
queries_used: cbaonline.cz navigation fetch

candidates.source_name: ČBA Monitor
candidates.why_relevant: Separate ČBA-run analytical/monitoring property linked from the main site. Likely carries sector data and commentary that contextualises regulatory impact; worth profiling as its own feed rather than assuming it duplicates cbaonline.cz.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Manual profiling pass first, then targeted crawl of its publication index
candidates.discovered_via_method: link found in ČBA site navigation
queries_used: cbaonline.cz navigation fetch

candidates.source_name: ČBA — legacy/parallel domain czech-ba.cz (incl. EN 'About CBA')
candidates.why_relevant: A second ČBA domain still surfacing live sections (e.g. /cs/o-cba/komise-pracovni-organy, /en/about-cba) and cited by ČNB as the association's official URL. May hold archived documents no longer on cbaonline.cz — valuable for historical position papers.
candidates.access_status: bot-defended (HTTP 403 on automated fetch) — likely live in a browser
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Browser-based fetch with realistic UA/headers; fall back to Wayback Machine snapshots
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowball from ČNB association directory + search
queries_used: Czech Banking Association European Banking Federation member position paper
candidates.observed_blocker: WebFetch of https://www.czech-ba.cz/cs returned HTTP 403 Forbidden; treated as bot-defended-but-live hypothesis, not dead

candidates.source_name: ČBA Educa / cbaeducaplus.cz — odborné semináře
candidates.why_relevant: ČBA's training arm. Seminar titles and agendas (e.g. AML seminars with the regulator's view) are a leading indicator of which regulatory changes banks are being prepared for and on what timeline; speaker lists name ČNB/MF officials and bank compliance leads.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly scrape of seminar listings; extract title, date, speaker, regulatory topic
queries_used: Česká bankovní asociace stanovisko legislativa připomínky

candidates.source_name: Sdružení pro bankovní karty (SBK) — bankovnikarty.cz
candidates.why_relevant: The card-industry association for CZ (founded 1991 as Mezibankovní sdružení pro platební karty). Describes itself as a sector platform covering technology, security, LEGISLATION and regulation, statistics and member education; issues Security Rules for cardholders and runs the 'Port of Security' conference. Core cell actor for card/payments regulation.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl public static pages (o_sbk_*, profil_statistiky, blokace_karet); do NOT attempt the secure member area
queries_used: Sdružení pro bankovní karty regulace karetních plateb

candidates.source_name: SBK — Aktuality (news/press archive subdomain)
candidates.why_relevant: SBK's running news archive, carrying member and scheme press releases (Mastercard, Visa) as recently as August 2026. Useful for dated card-scheme and card-regulation announcements aggregated in one Czech-language place.
candidates.legal_status: public website; third-party press releases retain their own copyright
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Weekly crawl of the archive index; store link + date + issuer
queries_used: Sdružení pro bankovní karty regulace karetních plateb

candidates.source_name: SBK — Statistiky karetního trhu
candidates.why_relevant: Aggregated CZ card-market statistics (ATM withdrawals, cashless transactions, e-commerce transactions, volumes, card counts). Not regulation per se, but the denominator for assessing the impact/urgency of card regulation and for sizing the regulated population.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Quarterly fetch; charts may be images/JS — check for underlying data endpoint before OCR
queries_used: Sdružení pro bankovní karty regulace karetních plateb

candidates.source_name: Česká fintech asociace / Czech FinTech Association (ČEFTAS)
candidates.why_relevant: Founded 2016, ~80 members (fintechs, banks, law firms, software houses). Explicitly positions itself as advocacy liaison to regulators; member directory is a pointer to the CZ fintech regulated population. English site at /en. Publishes articles, a FinTech Roadmap podcast and a newsletter that carry the industry reading of PSD3/PSR/MiCA.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl members directory (one-off + quarterly), article/blog index (weekly), newsletter archive; cs and /en variants
queries_used: Česká fintech asociace konzultace regulace stanovisko PSD3
"fintechcesko.cz" OR "czechfintech" Česká fintech asociace webové stránky

candidates.source_name: ČLFA — Česká leasingová a finanční asociace (main site)
candidates.why_relevant: 35 members covering ~86% of non-bank business financing, ~83% of non-bank consumer financing and ~95% of factoring in CZ. Actively co-drafts legislation on consumer credit/leasing and publicly comments on transposition timing (e.g. CCD2 in the consumer credit act amendment approved by government 16 Mar 2026, with ČLFA warning about the Nov 2026 effective date). Strong A3 deadline signal.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl /pro-media/tiskove-zpravy and /pro-odbornou-verejnost/stanoviska-clfa; harvest PDF/DOC attachments; quarterly stats pages
queries_used: ČLFA Česká leasingová a finanční asociace legislativa stanoviska

candidates.source_name: ČLFA — Stanoviska ČLFA (position papers)
candidates.why_relevant: The association's formal positions library: statements to government, joint memoranda (e.g. joint memorandum on CCD dated 3 Dec 2021), guidance on credit moratoria, vehicle return after lease termination, disclosure obligations. Directly the A3 'position paper / consultation response' artefact type, as PDF/DOC with dates.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape listing, download PDF/DOC attachments, extract title+date, text-extract for topic tagging
queries_used: ČLFA Česká leasingová a finanční asociace legislativa stanoviska

candidates.source_name: ČLFA — Členské společnosti (member directory)
candidates.why_relevant: Directory of the ~35 member firms; combined with the stated market-share figures it defines the non-bank regulated population addressed by consumer-credit/leasing regulation. Feeds entity resolution for other workstreams.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off scrape + semi-annual refresh; cross-match to ČNB registers and obchodní rejstřík (IČO)
queries_used: ČLFA Česká leasingová a finanční asociace legislativa stanoviska

candidates.source_name: AKAT ČR — Asociace pro kapitálový trh (main site)
candidates.why_relevant: Capital-market/collective-investment association (2008 merger of AFAM ČR and AKAT). Site is unusually well structured for A3: separate sections for laws & decrees, association documents, EFAMA documents, press releases, news, event calendar and member list — i.e. one hub covering rules, positions, deadlines and the regulated population.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Section-level crawl; an RSS option was observed on document listings — prefer feeds over scraping where present

candidates.source_name: AKAT ČR — Dokumenty AKAT (association documents / standards / positions)
candidates.why_relevant: Verified to contain dated association artefacts: strategy 2026-2030 (30 Mar 2026), fund classification methodology (Jun 2024, with the prior version's validity end date given), best-interest-of-client standards for investment services (Jun 2024), a ČNB reply on distribution rules (Mar 2022), and an association position on dividend payments (Jan 2022). RSS feed offered.

queries_used: AKAT ČR asociace kapitálového trhu legislativa stanoviska konzultace

candidates.why_relevant: AKAT republishes EFAMA (European Fund and Asset Management Association) material for Czech members. This is the mechanism by which EU-level consultation responses reach the CZ industry — useful for linking EU consultations to the domestic reading, and an English-language entry point in an otherwise cs cell.

candidates.source_name: ODOK / VeKLEP — eKLEP pro veřejnost (inter-ministerial comment procedure)
candidates.why_relevant: The government legislative portal where draft laws pass through 'meziresortní připomínkové řízení'. Association comments (ČBA, ČLFA, AKAT, ČEFTAS via Hospodářská komora or as připomínková místa) end up here as vypořádání tables — the single best place to see an association's actual, dated, itemised objections to a draft, which no association page reproduces in full.
candidates.legal_status: public government portal; official documents, free reuse under CZ rules
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll material pages by KORNA/ALBS-style identifiers; monitor new materials tagged to MF ČR / financial market; download the vypořádání připomínek attachments and grep for association names
candidates.discovered_via_method: cs-language search for the comment-procedure mechanism (snowball beyond association sites)

negative_findings.description: Neither cbaonline.cz nor its /en mirror exposed a browsable 'Stanoviska' / 'Připomínky' / 'Position papers' section in the navigation returned by fetching the homepage, /o-nas and /bankovni-regulace. Regulatory commentary appears to be dispersed across news articles, press releases and the codes-and-standards library instead.
negative_findings.result_summary: ČBA's formal consultation responses are not published as a discrete, indexed collection on its own site — unlike ČLFA (/pro-odbornou-verejnost/stanoviska-clfa) and AKAT (/Dokumenty/Dokumenty-AKAT).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A3 collection for ČBA cannot rely on a positions index; it must be assembled from ODOK vypořádání tables, EBA/EC consultation archives and press releases. Plan for a heavier, multi-source pipeline for the single most important association in the cell.

negative_findings.description: https://www.czech-ba.cz/cs returned HTTP 403 Forbidden to automated fetch, despite ČNB citing czech-ba.cz as ČBA's official URL and search results surfacing live-looking subpages (/en/about-cba, /cs/o-cba/komise-pracovni-organy).
negative_findings.result_summary: Bot defence hypothesis, not a dead site. Not recorded as dead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If czech-ba.cz holds archived ČBA documents that cbaonline.cz dropped, an automated crawler will silently miss them. Requires browser-based or Wayback-based collection.

negative_findings.description: https://www.cbaonline.cz/kodexy-a-standardy served a 'Page not found' page while https://cbaonline.cz/kodexy-a-standardy is indexed and live; conversely /o-nas/komise-pracovni-skupiny surfaced under the www host.
negative_findings.result_summary: www vs non-www routing on cbaonline.cz is inconsistent per path.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A crawler normalising to one host form will generate false 404s and could wrongly mark ČBA sections dead. Canonicalisation must be tested per path, and a 404 on one host must trigger a retry on the other before any liveness verdict.

negative_findings.description: The ČLFA stanoviska page's visible items span 2015-2021, most recent being a joint memorandum on CCD dated 3 December 2021 — yet ČLFA was demonstrably active on the CCD2 consumer credit amendment in March 2026 via press releases.
negative_findings.result_summary: The formal positions library lags the association's actual advocacy by years; current positions are being issued as press releases instead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Monitoring only the stanoviska section would produce a false 'ČLFA inactive' signal. Press releases (/pro-media/tiskove-zpravy) must be the primary ČLFA channel, with stanoviska as the archive.

negative_findings.description: Czech FinTech Association (ČEFTAS): searches in both cs and en for consultation responses or position papers on PSD3/PSR returned no association-authored position document. Its own site navigation shows only Home / About / Projects / Members / Contact / Membership plus articles, a podcast and a newsletter.
negative_findings.result_summary: ČEFTAS advocacy appears to be conducted informally (direct dialogue with MF ČR/ČNB) rather than through published stanoviska.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: For fintech-side regulatory positions, expect to rely on podcast/newsletter/article content, member law firms (e.g. FINREG PARTNERS, ARROWS) and MF ČR consultation summaries rather than association documents.

negative_findings.description: SBK operates a private member portal at data.bankovnikarty.cz/secure/private.htm; ČLFA has a /pro-cleny area. Member circulars — explicitly part of this cell's brief — appear to live behind these gates.
negative_findings.result_summary: Member circulars are not publicly accessible for SBK or ČLFA; no attempt was made to access gated areas.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The 'member circulars' element of the cell is structurally uncollectable from open sources. It must be substituted by press releases, seminar agendas and ODOK comment tables, or obtained through legitimate membership/subscription.

negative_findings.description: No Czech-language term was found for a formal 'consultation response' artefact type published by ČBA; the domestic vocabulary is 'připomínky' / 'vypořádání připomínek' (comments in the inter-ministerial procedure) rather than the EU-style 'stanovisko ke konzultaci'. 'Stanovisko' in CZ financial-market usage most often denotes a ČNB supervisory opinion, not an industry position.
negative_findings.result_summary: Term ambiguity: 'stanovisko' is a noisy query term that returns ČNB supervisory opinions rather than association positions.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Query design for this cell must prefer 'připomínky', 'připomínkové řízení', 'vypořádání připomínek', 'memorandum', 'pozice' over 'stanovisko' when targeting associations, and reserve 'stanovisko' for ČLFA/AKAT where it is their own section label.

negative_findings.description: No association in this cell was found to publish a dedicated REGULATORY DEADLINE calendar (transposition dates, effective dates, consultation closing dates). ČBA and AKAT publish event calendars only; SBK publishes conference/seminar announcements.
negative_findings.result_summary: Event calendars exist (cbaonline.cz/o-nas/kalendar, akatcr.cz/Dokumenty/Kalendar-udalosti); regulatory deadline calendars do not.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The 'regulatory event calendar' element of the cell brief must be constructed by inference from event titles plus ODOK/MF ČR milestones, not harvested ready-made.

coverage_gaps.description: Member circulars — one of the four artefact types named in this cell — are behind member logins at SBK and ČLFA and are not surfaced at all by ČBA or ČEFTAS.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Decide policy: either accept the gap and substitute open proxies (press releases, seminar agendas, ODOK comment tables, law-firm client alerts summarising circulars), or pursue a legitimate membership/subscription. Do not attempt to access gated areas.

coverage_gaps.description: czech-ba.cz could not be fetched (403) and cbamonitor.cz was catalogued from a navigation link only, without inspecting its publication index. Both may hold substantial A3 material.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a browser-based (non-WebFetch) profiling pass over czech-ba.cz and cbamonitor.cz, plus Wayback Machine snapshots of czech-ba.cz to recover any archived ČBA position documents.

coverage_gaps.description: The cell seed list omits several associations that ČNB itself recognises and that touch payments/banking regulation: Asociace družstevních záložen (ADZ, credit unions), Asociace penzijních společností ČR (APS ČR), Česká asociace společností finančního poradenství a zprostředkování (ČASF), Česká asociace pojišťoven (ČAP), plus Česká kryptoměnová asociace (ČKMA) and the Hospodářská komora as a formal comment place.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extend the cell to profile ADZ, APS ČR, ČASF and ČKMA using the ČNB association directory as the authoritative seed list; assign ČAP to an insurance cell if out of sector scope.

coverage_gaps.description: ODOK/VeKLEP is identified as the single highest-value place to find dated, itemised association comments, but no reliable way to enumerate materials by respondent or by financial-market topic was established in this pass — only two example material IDs were observed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Do a dedicated technical spike on odok.gov.cz: determine whether VeKLEP exposes a search/filter API or predictable listing by submitting ministry (MF ČR) and stage, and how vypořádání připomínek attachments are named, so association names can be grepped at scale.

coverage_gaps.description: English-language coverage of this cell is thin and mostly EU-hosted (EBA responses, EFAMA relays, /en mirrors that are shallower than the cs originals). ČEFTAS is the only cell actor with a substantive English site.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Treat cs as the primary collection language for all five named associations; use EN only for EU-level artefacts (EBA/ESMA/EC consultation responses, EBF/EFAMA) and do not rely on /en mirrors for completeness.

coverage_gaps.description: An RSS option was observed on AKAT document listings, but no systematic check for RSS/Atom/iCal feeds was performed across cbaonline.cz, clfa.cz, bankovnikarty.cz or czechfintech.cz.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a feed-discovery sweep (check <link rel=alternate>, /rss, /feed, sitemap.xml) on every cell domain before committing to HTML scraping; feeds materially reduce fragility and load.

brief: The Czech association layer for banking and payments is real, active and well-populated, but its regulatory output is published very unevenly: ČLFA and AKAT maintain explicit, dated positions/documents libraries (clfa.cz/pro-odbornou-verejnost/stanoviska-clfa, akatcr.cz/Dokumenty/Dokumenty-AKAT), whereas ČBA — by far the most important actor, with 34 members and over 99% of the sector — publishes no discrete consultation-response index and instead disperses its regulatory reading across news, press releases, its commissions structure and its self-regulatory codes-and-standards library (open banking, client mobility, banking identity), which are themselves quasi-regulatory instruments with their own effective dates. SBK covers the card perimeter with public statistics, security rules and a legislation/regulation remit but keeps member material behind a login, and the Czech FinTech Association advocates informally rather than through published papers. The decisive structural finding is that the association's actual, itemised, dated objections to Czech drafts live not on association sites but in the government's ODOK/VeKLEP inter-ministerial comment procedure and, at EU level, in EBA/EFAMA consultation archives — so this cell should be collected as association-site monitoring plus a process-side pipeline over ODOK, using cs terms 'připomínky'/'vypořádání připomínek' rather than the noisy 'stanovisko'.
